cohort: All women who gave birth in Princess Christian Maternity Hospital (PCMH) in Freetown, Sierra Leone, between October 1, 2020, and January 31, 2021.
finding: The study revealed a notably high caesarean section rate (49.6%) in a tertiary hospital in Sierra Leone, particularly among low-risk Robson groups 1 (43%) and 3 (33%) with associated adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: A high caesarean section rate (49.6%) was observed, with 95% of women with a previous CS undergoing repeat CS, and high rates (43% and 33%) even in low-risk Robson groups 1 and 3.
